# GW8 Crypto Regime + WaveTrend Signal API (x402)
> Pay-per-call crypto market signals for AI agents. USDC on Base via x402 v2. Signal only, no trading, not financial advice.

## Start here (free)
- GET /api/sample — live Stage 1 regime statuses, core WaveTrend values, band-dot count.
- GET /llms.txt — this file.
- GET /openapi.json — machine-readable paid + free routes (x402scan OpenAPI-first discovery).
- GET /.well-known/x402 — resource fan-out list for indexers.
- GET /track and GET /api/track — honest track record. Backtest section is **simulated** (rolling ~90 days). Live log accrues after deploy (label shows "live log not started yet" until the first logged dot).
- GET /api/stats and /stats.html — per-endpoint request tallies (402 quotes vs paid). No IPs or PII.
- GET /api/proof/pubkey — Ed25519 public key for signed paid responses.
- GET /api/govcontracts/status, /api/kraken/listings/status, /api/rules/status — free source-health checks (no paid rows).

## What agents search for
| Need | Call | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Crypto market regime (risk-on/risk-off) | GET /api/regime or POST /api/agent | $0.01 / $0.02 |
| WaveTrend oversold/overbought dots | GET /api/dots or GET /api/coin/{symbol} | $0.01 / $0.005 |
| Simulated hit-rate backtest | GET /api/history | $0.05 |
| Kraken new listings | GET /api/kraken/listings | $0.02 |
| Tokenized RWA flows | GET /api/rwa | $0.02 |
| Federal contract awards | GET /api/govcontracts | $0.02 |
| CFTC/SEC crypto rule changes | GET /api/rules | $0.02 |
| Green-dot webhook alerts | POST /api/alerts/subscribe | $0.50 |
| Day pass (24h, most paid routes) | POST /api/pass/day | $1.00 |

## Paid endpoints (what you get / when to use)
- POST /api/agent ($0.02): full snapshot — Stage 1 regime score 0-4 + WaveTrend 10/21/4 band dots on 66 Kraken 4h pairs. Use for a one-shot scan. Example shape: `{ signal: { stage1: { score, outOf, checks }, wavetrend: { bandDots, universe: 66 } } }`.
- GET /api/regime ($0.01): Stage 1 detail only (ETF 3-day net flow, BTC quiet support, alt breadth, Fear & Greed). Use for regime context before other calls.
- GET /api/dots ($0.01): current green/red WaveTrend band dots (inner ≤-53 / ≥53, outer ≤-60 / ≥60) across 66 pairs, last 6 closed 4h bars.
- GET /api/coin/:symbol ($0.005): WaveTrend 4h for one coin (cheapest). Example: `{ name: "BTC", wt1, wt2, dots }`.
- GET /api/history ($0.05, optional ?pair=BTC): **simulated** 90-day band-dot backtest with forward %+4h/+24h/+3d and hit-rate summary. Not a live trade log. Past performance ≠ future results.
- GET /api/verdict/:chain/:address ($0.02): token safety score 0-100 → safe/caution/danger (GoPlus + DexScreener, fixed rules). Automated screen, not a guarantee. Chains: base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, solana.
- GET /api/flows/:symbol ($0.02): Kraken large-print buy/sell summary (single venue, not on-chain) + WaveTrend 4h state.
- GET /api/brief ($0.05): once-per-day (Mountain Time) digest — regime, dot counts, top coins, BTC/ETH/SOL flows.
- GET /api/rwa ($0.02): tokenized RWA flows — protocol TVL, 7d change/estimated flows, movers, yields, top RWA tokens (DefiLlama + CoinGecko, 10-min cache).
- GET /api/govcontracts ($0.02, optional ?ticker= ?sector= ?q=): federal contract awards (14-day USAspending actions) to AI/drone/nuclear/robotics/space/quantum/defense-tech. **Defense/DoD awards are about 90 days late** via USAspending; war.gov announcements currently unavailable from our host (check /api/govcontracts/status).
- GET /api/kraken/listings ($0.02): Kraken new USD pairs (30 days) with price, volume, % since listing, WaveTrend state.
- GET /api/rules ($0.02): CFTC + SEC crypto rule-change feed (90 days) with RIN, comment deadlines, stage changes.
- POST /api/alerts/subscribe ($0.50): webhook for NEW green WaveTrend band dots (30 days or 300 alerts, HMAC-signed). Body `{ "webhookUrl": "https://…", "filter": "outer|inner|all", "pairs?": ["BTC"] }`. Invalid bodies rejected before payment.
- POST /api/brief/weekly/subscribe ($0.25): 4 Monday webhook briefs (regime, dots, hit rates, RWA, gov; DoD ~90d lag).
- POST /api/pass/day ($1.00): 24h access to paid data endpoints via `X-GW8-Pass` (fair use 2000/day, 60/min). Excludes alert subscribe. Token shown once.

## Payment
- x402 v2, scheme exact, network eip155:8453, asset USDC `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`, payTo `0xB4527dccaC81eB73d4988A51a4cb1FBBF2C3CaBd`.
- Unpaid requests return **402** with `PAYMENT-REQUIRED`. Retry with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`.
- Discovery: `/openapi.json` (preferred), `/.well-known/x402` (fan-out). CDP Bazaar lists a route after the first successful facilitator **settlement** for that resource.

## Honesty labels
- History/track **backtest** = simulated.
- Track **live log** = starts empty until the running service logs its first band dot.
- Gov **DoD/defense** awards ≈ 90-day USAspending lag; no live war.gov scrape from our host today.
- All outputs are signal only — not financial advice, no trade execution.
